messages:
Mia L: rolling the model-serving config to prod now (slice B -> new route). will ping when canary finishes, please run quick sanity if you are on watchlist

deploy-bot: deploy started by @Mia L — commit 9f3b2c (rdw/model-serve). canary: 10% -> 50% staged per policy

Alejandro: which routes are in the slice? need to know which customer-facing endpoints to check

Mia L: routes: `/v1/generate`, `/v1/chat/stream` behind the feature-flag `new-kv-cache`. subset of traffic (slice B) only

Sam: doing basic smoke now — hitting health and a tiny generation. posting commands:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.com/v1/health || echo "health-fail"
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping","max_tokens":4}' | jq .
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/rdw-model-serve --watch=false
```

Sam: health OK, rollout status `success`, sample gen looks fine (latency ~210ms p50)

Natalie: checking observability dashboards — latency spike on /v1/chat/stream at canary start (+350ms p50) but CPU on GPUs stable. traces show increased KV cache misses for long prompts

Mia L: noted. is that within our canary threshold? I set alert window to 5m with 25% allowed degradation for canary

Natalie: it bumps the alert to WARNING but not firing escalate yet. recommend watching for 10 more minutes. will post link: https://dash.redwood.prod/d/serving/canary-overview?uid=2815

Ryan: rollback plan ready if needed: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/rdw-model-serve --to-revision=3` and toggle feature-flag `new-kv-cache` off in console (takes <30s to propagate). I have chestnut access and will execute on 👍

Alejandro: quick QA: reran 3 sample prompts including long context — outputs look coherent. KV misses caused small latency but no quality regressions

Sam: also ran a tiny traffic replay (100 reqs) against canary, error rate 0.2% (mostly 429s from throttling), overall QPS steady

Mia L: OK let's let canary reach 100% over next 10m. Natalie & Sam keep watch on latency and error-rate. Ryan, hold for rollback on standby. I'll update when rollout completes
deploy-bot: canary progressed to 100% at 2815001359 — all pods reported ready. uptime check: 120s.

Natalie: final check — p50 stable ~220ms, errors back to baseline, KV misses decreasing. no action from infra team

Mia L: excellent — closing watch. will create a short postmortem if anything pops next 24h. thanks everyone :rocket:
